note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: a real India->Nepal consignment dated 2025-07-14, B/L 3544059, buyer Palpa Cement Industries Ltd (Kathmandu, Nepal), routed Sonauli LCS -> Bhairawa. Declared HS 843131 matches the actual customs HS on the main line (84313100, parts of lifts/skip hoists), so no HS correction is needed; the same B/L also carries 84313910 and 73129000 lines, i.e. the company ships mixed lift/spare-parts consignments. Only one trading partner is listed ("Trading Partners 1"), so this is a single-buyer, single-corridor export flow rather than a broad export programme. Domestic supply evidence could not be established: DuckDuckGo search returned a connection error on both attempts, and volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com returned HTTP 403; no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract record was retrieved, so domestic_status is unknown and GST turnover is null (not invented). No registry or catalogue data was used. Note the address on record is a commercial-complex office (62-A, GDA Commercial Complex, Nyay Khand-1, Indirapuram) with no plant shown, consistent with a trader/stockist role rather than a manufacturer, though role classification is outside this task.
